quotes.author: Renee Gutierrez
quotes.text: Our tour guide Malcolm, was very knowledgeable, kind, accommodating. He answered all our questions, assisted us to get in and out of the van, patiently waited while we toured Sedona Arizona and the Grand Canyon. Malcolm made our trip enjoyable and memorable, we will treasure our memories for years to come. The sunset portion of the trip is worth the extra cost. Thank you Todd for providing such a quality and accommodating service. Renee Gutierrez

quotes.author: Gary Geiman
quotes.text: We had a great trip to the Grand Canyon with Malcolm as our driver and tour guide. This was a bucket list trip for my wife and we couldn’t have asked for a better trip! From the moment we were picked up until we were dropped off, this was a first class, 5-star experience. We definitely plan on using this service again in the future! By the way, if you get the chance to rent the Maybach, do it! It was such a great ride in a fabulous car!

quotes.author: Susie Webb
quotes.text: My niece rented from Todd's for six of us to go to the Grand Canyon. Our driver, Bob, was absolutely perfect! He was considerate, helpful and very knowledgeable about the Grand Canyon. The car was very comfortable and clean. It was beyond an excellent trip! I would highly recommend Todd's for anyone!

quotes.author: Anthony Howard
quotes.text: In a word AMAZING!!! Bobby Love made our Grand Canyon tour an incredible memory. His fun commentaries & area knowledge was priceless. There were 6 of us who all agreed this was an awesome experience! Thanks Bobby & Todd!

quotes.author: Leann Moreno
quotes.text: This was my family's first experience booking Todd's Tours private tours! Malcolm is the Man! The Grand Canyon was our destination and Malcolm provided with us the best experience!

quotes.author: Matt Knighton
quotes.text: Todd was extremely responsive and the drivers were very attentive to our needs. The cars were clean and very effective for our party of 4 travelling on business.
